name: hold_invoice
title: Hold invoice
description: Hold an invoice so it is not paid until a person has looked, with the reason (e.g. 'price 6% above the order'). Holding twice is harmless.

reason.description: what is wrong, in plain words

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by the supplier's number or its id) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat
